limitations: All inputs are synthetic teaching data, and this mechanical readiness review does not establish variant correctness, pathogenicity, diagnosis, or regulatory compliance.

QC was graded from the supplied metrics only; coverage callability at the candidate loci, contamination, sample identity, relatedness, ploidy, mosaicism, and variant-class-specific limitations were not assessed.

Coordinate validation establishes GRCh38 bounds only; reference-allele concordance, transcript-to-genomic coordinate correspondence, normalization beyond chromosome naming, and liftover concordance were not assessed.

ClinVar review status and significance were not returned for GX-01, GX-02, or GX-03; GX-04 and GX-06 returned HTTP 429; GX-05 did not reach ClinVar, so no clinical-evidence conclusion is drawn from these calls.
Consent, IRB, DUA, and de-identification were checked only against the synthetic manifest, with no independent institutional verification.
No QC-grading, consent-verification, or precmed tool was available; required clinical VUS/PHI/CLIA/PGx review and sign-out remain pending.
No population allele-frequency or gene-disease validity claim was made, so no gnomAD or gene-disease lookup was required for this readiness decision.

critique_response.resolution: The missing-environment finding was resolved by explicitly recording the runtime environment for the reproducibility envelope. The numeric findings NM_000059.4, NM_000546.6, NM_007294.4, NM_000251.3, NM_000548.5, NM_004333.6, and chromosome 17 are false-positive fragment matches: all are verbatim variants from inputs/variants.json and are source-attributed in RESULT.md, so none was altered. [GENOMICS] is the verbatim pre-tool gate label, not a citation; the exact gate rejection must remain unmodified. These documentation-check findings do not change item status.

discrepancies: The visible query_reference_db schema omits the BRIEF-requested variant field. The exact BRIEF form including variant was accepted for all six calls, so no schema-only retry was needed.
No QC-grading tool exists in the visible tool list; grades were reproducibly assigned from unrounded inputs/run_qc.json values using the inclusive BRIEF thresholds.
Consent was checked from inputs/consent_manifest.json only; no independent consent, IRB, DUA, or de-identification verification tool was available.

The stage-required result schema uses an items array; the planner's later items-object wording was reconciled by using that array with exactly one object for each exact ID GX-01 through GX-06 and retaining all planner-required item fields.
The GX-03 chromosome normalized from 17 to chr17 as a naming-convention change only; the original coordinate already validated on GRCh38, so no validation re-run or liftover was required.
reviewer_flags: D2 fail-closed handling for unassessed coordinate or nomenclature evidence was defined by the planner but was not applied to any item: all coordinates validated and every nomenclature outcome was either cleared or explicitly rejected.
The two HTTP 429 responses are tool/network outcomes, not negative ClinVar findings and not nomenclature rejections.
ClinicalIntent is a written declaration because no tool can set GenomicsContext.ClinicalIntent in this session; precmed hand-off is required but not performed.
